```lean
let n := ⌊x⌋₊
have h_n_le_x : ↑n ≤ x := by simp [floor_le]
have h_pi_bound : π(n) ≤ Real.log 4 * n / Real.log √x + √x := 
  by {
    have h_log_sqrt_x_pos : 0 < Real.log √x := 
      by { rw Real.log_pos, exact (Real.sqrt_pos (by linarith)).mpr (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (by linarith)) },
    have h_log_4_pos : 0 < Real.log 4 := by { rw Real.log_pos, exact (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (by linarith)) },
    have h_denom_nonzero : Real.log √x ≠ 0 := 
      by { rw Real.log_eq_zero, exact (Real.sqrt_pos (by linarith)).mp (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.1 (by linarith)) },
    have h_div_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log 4 * n / Real.log √x := 
      by { apply le_div_of_pos_left, exact h_log_4_pos, exact h_log_sqrt_x_pos },
    have h_sqrt_x_pos : 0 < √x := by { rw Real.sqrt_pos, exact (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (by linarith)) },
    have h_sqrt_x_le_x : √x ≤ x := by { rw Real.sqrt_le, exact (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (by linarith)).mp (Real.le_self _) },
    have h_upper_bound : π(n) ≤ n / Real.log n + n / (Real.log n)^2 := 
      by {
        apply Real.pi_upper_bound,
        exact Nat.cast_pos.2 (by linarith),
      },
    have h_log_n_le_log_x : Real.log n ≤ Real.log x := 
      by { apply Real.log_increasing, exact (Nat.cast_pos.2 (by linarith)).mp (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (by linarith)) },
    have h_log_n_pos : 0 < Real.log n := 
      by { rw Real.log_pos, exact (Nat.cast_pos.2 (by linarith)).mp (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (by linarith)) },
    have h_log_n_le_log_4 : Real.log n ≤ Real.log 4 := 
      by { apply Real.log_increasing, exact (Nat.cast_pos.2 (by linarith)).mp (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (by linarith)) },
    have h_log_4_ge_log_n : Real.log 4 ≥ Real.log n := h_log_n_le_log_4,
    have h_n_le_x : n ≤ x := h_n_le_x,
    have h_n_ge_1 : n ≥ 1 := by { rw Nat.cast_one, exact (Nat.floor_le x).mp (by linarith) },
    have h_log_n_ge_0 : Real.log n ≥ 0 := by { rw Real.log_pos, exact (Nat.cast_pos.2 (by linarith)).mp (Real.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (by linarith)) },
    have h_n_over_log_n_le_n_over_log_4 : n / Real.log n ≤ n / Real.log 4 := 
      by { apply le_div_of_pos_left, exact h_log_n_pos, exact h_log_4_pos },
    have h_n_over_log_4_le_n_over_log_sqrt_x : n / Real.log 4 ≤ n / Real.log √x := 
      by { apply le_div_of_pos_left, exact h_log_4_pos, exact h_log_sqrt_x_pos },
    have h_n_over_log_n_plus_n_over_log_n_sq_le_n_over_log_4_plus_n_over_log_sqrt_x : 
      n / Real.log n + n / (Real.log n)^2 ≤ n / Real.log 4 + n / Real.log √x := 
      by {
        apply add_le_add,
        exact h_n_over_log_n_le_n_over_log_4,
        apply le_div_of_pos_left,
        exact h_log_n_pos,
        exact h_log_sqrt_x_pos,
      },
    have h_n_over_log_4_plus_n_over_log_sqrt_x_le_real_log_4_times_n_over_log_sqrt_x_plus_sqrt_x : 
      n / Real.log 4 + n / Real.log √x ≤ Real.log 4 * n / Real.log √x + √x := 
      by {
        have h_n_over_log_4_le_real_log_4_times_n_over_log_sqrt_x : 
          n / Real.log 4 ≤ Real.log 4 * n / Real.log √x := 
          by {
            apply le_div_of_pos_left,
            exact h_log_4_pos,
            exact h_log_sqrt_x_pos,
          },
        have h_n_over_log_sqrt_x_le_sqrt_x : 
          n / Real.log √x ≤ √x := 
          by {
            apply le_div_of_pos_left,
            exact h_log_sqrt_x_pos,
            exact h_sqrt_x_pos,
          },
        exact add_le_add h_n_over_log_4_le_real_log_4_times_n_over_log_sqrt_x h_n_over_log_sqrt_x_le_sqrt_x,
      },
    calc
      π(n) ≤ n / Real.log n + n / (Real.log n)^2
      ≤ n / Real.log 4 + n / Real.log √x
      ≤ Real.log 4 * n / Real.log √x + √x
      by linarith
  }
have h_pi_n_le_pi_x : π(n) ≤ π(x) := by {
  have h_n_lt_x : n < x := by {
    have h_n_le_x : ↑n ≤ x := h_n_le_x,
    have h_n_lt_x : ↑n < x := by {
      rcases lt_or_le (↑n) x with h | h,
      exact h,
      have h_n_eq_x : ↑n = x := by {
        have h_n_le_x : ↑n ≤ x := h_n_le_x,
        have h_x_lt_n : x < ↑n := h,
        contradiction,
      },
      contradiction,
    },
  },
  exact Real.pi_monotone h_n_lt_x,
}
calc
  π(x) ≤ π(n) + 1
  ≤ (Real.log 4 * n / Real.log √x + √x) + 1
  ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x
  by linarith
```
